sentences.text: Cameron Jibril Thomaz -LRB- born September 8 , 1987 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Wiz Khalifa , is an American rapper , songwriter , and actor .	stage name	stage name
He released his debut album , Show and Prove , in 2006 , and signed to Warner Bros. .	Show and Prove	Show and Prove
